properties.description:
TORTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Tornado Warning for...
South Central Graham County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 445 PM MST.

* At 402 PM MST, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado
was located 19 miles northwest of Willcox, moving northeast at 30
mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated rotation.

shelter. Mobile homes will be damaged or destroyed. Damage

likely.

properties.instruction:

away from windows. If you are outdoors, in a mobile home, or in a
vehicle, move to the closest substantial shelter and protect yourself
from flying debris.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 5:01PM MDT until October 21 at 8:00PM MDT by NWS Salt Lake City UT
properties.description:
FFWSLC

The National Weather Service in Salt Lake City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southeastern Iron County in southern Utah...
West Central Kane County in southern Utah...
East Central Washington County in southwestern Utah...

* Until 800 PM MDT.

* At 501 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across Zion Canyon within Zion National Park. Up to 0.25
inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to
0.75 inches are possible in the warned area with this current
storm, and additional thunderstorms remain likely over the next
several hours. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of slot canyons, normally
dry washes, creeks, and streams.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Zion National Park, Springdale and Rockville.
properties.instruction:
Move to higher ground now. Act quickly to protect your life.

Stay away or be swept away. River banks and culverts can become
unstable and unsafe.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 8:00 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 8:00 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

Coconino County in north central Arizona...

north at 65 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Tuba City, Cameron, Tappan Spring, Moenkopi, Coal Mine Mesa, Willow

Wednesday for a portion of north central Arizona.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued October 21 at 4:29PM MDT until October 21 at 7:30PM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
FFWABQ

The National Weather Service in Albuquerque has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central Lincoln County in central New Mexico...

* Until 730 PM MDT.

* At 429 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to 0.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Capitan and Smokey Bear Historical Park.

This includes Highway 380 between Mile Markers 78 and 82...and
between Mile Markers 85 and 87.

This includes the following low water crossings...
Capitan Gap Road at Salado Creek, Dean Drive at North Fork Salado
Creek, Sandia and Dean Drive at North Fork Salado Creek and Sandia
Drive at North Fork Salado Creek.

This includes the following recreation areas...
Smokey Bear Historical Park.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, north winds 25 to 30 kt with gusts
to 40 kt and seas 10 to 13 feet expected. For the Small Craft
Advisory, north winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts to 30 kt and seas
7 to 9 feet expected.

* WHERE...Waters from Pt. St. George to Cape Mendocino CA from
10 to 60 nm.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, from 6 PM Thursday to 9 PM PDT
Friday. For the Small Craft Advisory, from 9 AM to 6 PM PDT
Thursday.

capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

vessel for severe conditions.
